review_description: We recently had a 10 kW solar system with AIKO Solar Neostar 2S panels, a Sungrow inverter, and a 270 L Emerald Energy heat pump installed by Kennedy's Plumbing and Electrical, and we are very happy with the final results.From start to finish, the entire process was handled with professionalism. The team took the time to explain every detail, provided clear quotes with no hidden costs, answered all our questions and kept us informed at every stage. Installation days went smoothly. The crew were punctual, tidy, and clearly skilled at their profession.The AIKO Neostar 2S panels look fantastic on the roof and are performing exceptionally well, even on cloudy days. Paired with the Sungrow inverter, the system runs efficiently and gives us real time monitoring through various apps so we can easily track our energy production. The 270 L heat pump has also been a great addition, giving us plenty of hot water while working alongside the solar to keep our energy bills low.We’ve already seen a good reduction in our electricity costs in line with our goals that we discussed during our initial sit down meeting which is fantastic.The after installation follow up was exceptional. It’s clear that customer satisfaction is a real priority for the team. They made sure everything was working perfectly and continue to offer support even after the job was done (e.g. better utility provider options, guidance with utility providers, options for system add ons etc )I highly recommend Kennedy's Plumbing and Electrical to anyone considering solar, honest advice, excellent workmanship, and truly professional service from start to finish.

Kennedy’s are a highly professional and customer focussed company. My experience with them was fantastic.Daniel, the Sales Director, is highly knowledgeable about everything in the solar and battery storage industry. He visited our place to ensure he understood our requirements and came up with a great design and recommendations in relation to equipment etc. He was very happy to answer any questions I had and explained things in easily understandable "plain English".We purchased a 16.7kw solar system (38 x 440W Phono Solar Helios CLEAR panels) and a 24Kwh Sigenstor battery system with a 12kw Single Phase Hybrid controller.The in-house installation team (not a sub-contractor outfit) from Kennedy’s were hard working, polite and did a great job installing our system. Their work was very neat and tidy and I was consulted on any decisions required re placement of components and conduits etc. Angus Kennedy, one of the owners, also made a couple of site visits to follow up that all the work was completed to our satisfaction.After the Federal Government battery rebate came into effect, I asked the guys to install a further 16Kwh of battery storage. They completed this task very promptly and very professionally.As a further measure to “electrify” our home, I asked the Kennedy’s team to provide a recommendation to replace our 12 year old gas hot water storage system with a heat pump HWS. Daniel provided his recommendation and the Kennedy’s team then installed our Emerald 270 ltr Heat Pump WHS. The guys turned up as scheduled and had the job done in less than a half a day. They even completed a few extra plumbing tasks which I had on a list for a few months. Nothing was too much trouble for them.The Kennedy’s team use a WhatsApp group to facilitate communication between me and the full team. This was very helpful as we had some initial issues with our system (Sigenergy and Amber Electric related) and the guys were on the case to get everything resolved, ensuring that I was informed all along the way. Their dedication to resolve issues was first rate. Great customer service and support.My research into the adoption of solar and battery technology clearly identified that selecting the right installer is of paramount importance. This is definitely right.I am so happy that I selected Kennedy’s to do our installation. They are highly professional, extremely knowledgeable, committed to customer service and support as well as being friendly, good guys.Based on my experience, I highly recommend Kennedy’s.

We had an outstanding experience with Kennedy Solar from start to finish. Right from the quoting stage, they took the time to work with us to optimise the size and balance of our system – both solar and battery – so that it was tailored perfectly to our needs. Their communication was excellent, with a dedicated WhatsApp group keeping everyone (admin, sales and installers) in the loop throughout the process.The installation itself was incredibly smooth and fast, with the team working efficiently and professionally. What really stood out, though, was their persistence and problem-solving skills. Our farm setup is a little unusual, with multiple distribution points, and this presented some real challenges. The Kennedy Solar team were absolutely tenacious in finding a solution, never giving up until everything was running seamlessly.We couldn’t be happier with the outcome – both the service and the system itself have exceeded our expectations. Highly recommend Kennedy Solar for anyone looking for a reliable, knowledgeable, and customer-focused solar installer.

If you want to deal with a professional team for your solar and battery needs, these are the people to consider.They were the only installer I contacted who provided an onsite inspection and quote.From quote to install they provided a prompt professional service, keeping us fully informed at each step of the process, by email, SMS and whatsapp.Our install at a competitive price, of an extra 11kW of solar and a Sigenergy 3 phase system of 48kW battery, 30kW inverter with gateway for blackout protect, compared to other installs I have seen is excellent, being clean, tidy and neat without a wire or conduit anywhere in sight.We can't speak highly enough of this company. Thankyou to Angus and his team.
Kennedy's are great to deal with. They have great communication and excellent after sales service. They are always available to answer your questions.

Ordered a 24kw sigenstore system and an additional 8kw of panels to add on to my existing 6.6kw system.First solar installer I used was a cheaper run of the mill sub continent run type. While the system worked their work was sloppy. Broke multiple tiles and used silicon to glue them together Then never told me so I could replace them, ran lines in cheap conduits rather then feeding them through wall cavities etc.Kennedys did a fantastic job. Was very tidy and they always seem to be available to answer questions and provide support.

Highly recommend Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical - very professional from quoting, answering my many queries to the installation.  The quote was competitive, they managed the installation well and everything was left very tidy.

The whole process has been very smooth and easy for us.  After the initial contact, the sales consultant visited us and used a drone (with all sorts of smart technology built into it) to more accurately measure how many panels could be fitted onto our roof.  He ascertained our goals for getting the upgrade to our panels (ie, to get off gas and, later, to add a battery, a heat pump and an induction cooktop), explained all the reasons for the recommended panels and battery and answered our numerous questions.  He was always easy to contact and responsive to our queries.  The office contacts were all positive, too.  Once signing up with Kennedy's, they set up a WhatsApp group for you so that you can see the communications relating to your site.We planned to install the induction cooktop (Bosch) and the heat pump (Reclaim) later in the year, but changed our minds and decided to proceed with these items sooner rather than later.  The installation team accommodated our last-minute decision re the induction cooktop - and the heat pump will be installed next week.  The installers removed all rubbish and left our place clean and tidy. Although we have decided on the Sigenergy battery system, we will organise that later in the year once our usage needs can be fully assessed.  We own an electric vehicle and are happy to continue to trickle-charge for the time being, but know that the Sigenergy system will accommodate a charger if we later decide to go that way.We felt it was a bonus that Kennedy's handles electrical and plumbing matters, making it so much easier for us to proceed.We are really happy to recommend Kennedy's plumbing and electrical.NB:  The price listed here is for the solar panels and inverters, only.Ray & Karen

The process of obtaining a quote was friendly and thorough, including roof inspection and advice.The quote was clear and they fully explained the pros and cons of the installation components they were recommending as well as other options.The installation on the day was smooth, friendly and efficient. It was done in one day and the site was left clean. The installation crew explained everything, including installing the monitoring app on my phone, before they left.Follow-up service has been great. About a week after the installation, they have phoned to confirm that everything went well and have a brief discussion about how we were finding the system. Another follow-up conversation will happen in the near future when we have more statistics from the system and we can discuss how to optimise its use.Overall, we are very happy with how it has gone and would recommend Kennedy's to anyone.

From quotation to installation the whole team was knowledgeable and professional.We chose based on being a local business with their own installation team and this I feel has paid off in full.The installation team were very professional, punctual and I was blown away they managed to collect every last piece of the discarded packing material and take it away with them.

The team at Kennedy's are clearly a class apart from many.The quoting process was seamless and they were the only provider who kept their commitments to get back to me or to follow up on an issue. They made useful recommendations and given I wanted to pour my own slab and configure drainage for an all in one hot water service they got asked a range of extra questions. They were prompt in answering and clear in the answers provided. The price was over $1,000 less than a competitor for exactly the same item, that's value. The installation was very professionally executed and I had my first experience of a trade advising me they were running late, exceptional service. Ben and the team did an excellent job to exacting standards and they explained options to me and gave me sensible options to solve any challenges.I am having a few teething problems with the controller and app for the product, not Kennedy's issue, and to date James and his team have been following up for me, trying to get the manufacturer to sort out the issue. That's service that is worth a lot because at present I am not maximising my excess solar energy production into my hot water battery.Great job, good people. Highly recommended.

Sought a few quotes and Kennedy's were the only company to come out on site, run through our usage and requirements (we have 3 phase power for a large kiln on top of the usual) as well as shade mapping, size of system. Certainly created a bespoke view of our solar needs (and into the future) and we weren't pushed into a battery - suggested we review usage and size / install battery accordingly later on. No sales pressure. They have a customer focus that really creates an environment of trust. They know their Solar!Price was competitive, coming in lower than another with similar sized solar system.Prompt and detailed with quote and anticipated savings from rising energy costs. Communication always first class, clear and easy - especially with the Whatsapp group. Have had a few questions and response is always quick.Installation was on the day, at the time specified and was great to see in-house installers. Completed same day, with a thorough overview and the place left spotless. Attached photos show how good the install is and looks.Follow up has also been exceptional - contacted 6 weeks after install to review data, make some tweaks and switch grid providers for a more cost-effective blend.Highly recommend Kennedy's. They set a high bar for themselves to deliver the best for their customers and build a long term, supportive partnership. So glad we went with them.
Great correspondence, very punctual, quick installation and they organised electricity company to go with. Quick replies on their WhatsApp group

Prompt quote after initial contact.Quote included all relevant details.Follow up calls to - walk through proposal, discuss options, assess and recommend variations.Prompt facilitation of connection with grid and scheduling of installation.Pre-install reconnaissance visit - professionally conducted.Installation - punctual, minimal supply disruption, easy to talk to, neat work on roof and indoor, cleaning up of premises.Patient walkthrough of monitoring appCatch up 6-8 weeks after installation, discuss system performance and recommendation of best fit energy supplier.Very satisfied with KPE, no hesitation in recommending.

From the very first consultation to the final system check, Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical provided an exceptional solar installation experience. Their professionalism was evident at every stage, and the team's expertise and attention to detail were truly impressive. They patiently answered all my questions, offered clear and transparent advice, and delivered a high-quality installation that exceeded my expectations. The entire process was seamless, and the communication was outstanding. I am incredibly happy with my solar system, and I cannot recommend Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical highly enough. If you're looking for a reliable, professional, and top-notch solar installer, look no further!

In summary, overall a great installer, everyone on the team that I interacted with was patient, polite, informative, and punctual, system designed to fit our budget, installation was clean and tidy and done in a day, heat pump installed separately a few weeks later.Happy with the system so far, but ask me again in a few months/years. I appreciated how prompt and quick they were with answering my many questions, with arranging the quote and site inspections, and with making adjustments to fit our requirements.Heat pump was out of our budget at the time, but the old tank kicked the bucket and forced our hand, probably because it was hanging by a thread anyway, Dan was able to find a better price for us and we went ahead with it.Customer service was good, they helped arrange the smart meter to be installed by our electricity retailer, and provided support on the whatsapp group chat for a lot of other things. Not a big deal, but it would have helped save me some time if the EV Charger's quick guide was left with me.

We approached the quoting with a lot of skepticism - this was a new area and we were inclined to do a lot of research with a negative view. It took a lot of time and KPE were very patient. They changed their quote a number of times to suit our changing needs. (Thanks Sam)At the point of installation they gave us a very clear indication of timeframes and kept to them. The team arrived, were very efficient and friendly, explained everything as they proceeded and left the place neat and tidy.It is not often that you can say 5 out of 5 for everything - the system has been purring along for a week and amazing us over our morning coffee every day. The internet monitoring is better than great.This is likely or be our best investment to date.Thank you KPEBob and Lyn

From the initial meeting with salesperson Dan and the great advice we got from him, to the excellent installation job to the after sales experience, Kennedy's have been fantastic. They have excellent after sales service and have answered all my questions quickly and efficiently. I also had a video call a month after installing with Sam who checked in to make sure I was happy with everything and he also recommended that we change our energy provider to get a better deal, and will also check back with us in 6 months. Neighbours have commented how good the system looks as it's all black.

I knew next to nothing about getting into solar besides it being a huge scene. Kennedy's Plumbing and Electrical (KPE) was one of several installers that I got quotes from.On first contact, the sales rep, Daniel, did a general inspection in person before giving us actual quotes to consider. Daniel was courteous, genuine and gave straight-forward answers without any nonsense. He talked us through the entire process of what options we had and what factors to consider like budget, quality, and longevity when deciding on a solar plan. We were really happy with Daniel's proposal and signed up with KPE.In retrospect, I prefer Daniel's approach as a first step due to many installers giving me an instant quote on the phone based on satellite images, while it sounds good in theory, again, I knew nothing about solar, and I had no idea what was a good deal or not.After signing up, Daniel established a WhatsApp group for our address, with every lead personnel from KPE involved in the installation process. This is an amazing idea, because it allowed us to correspond with the several people involved in the project all at once without being confused on who's who and who does what; if I needed to ask something, I could throw it in the WhatsApp; if KPE needed something from me like a document or confirmation, they'd ask on the WhatsApp. This is far more preferable than having intermittent phone calls which you may or may not miss.Next was the pre-install site inspection. Angus, the head installer, came to do a proper inspection of the site before the installation, taking final measurements and prepping the roof design for submission. We had recently had our roof restored as well in preparation for solar as our roof hadn't been maintained once in over 20 years. Angus was very kind and shot a video showing where the solar panels would be installed and as well as the vastly improved condition of the roof after it had been restored, this part meant a lot to me because his input on the state the roof meant that we hadn't struck-out with the roof restorers.Installation was a breeze. The KPE team arrived promptly, they were ready to work and I could feel the confidence they had in their expertise. The job went smoothly and the site was clean with no dramas. They didn't even need a single spare roof tile we had prepared beforehand.After installation, I met with Angus once more so that he could show me how to monitoring app for the solar system as well as answer any further questions I had about the system. Angus also garnered a few drone shots of the installation and it looks astounding. Angus was very gracious and I was super happy with his and his team's work all throughout the project.A couple months after installation, I had a Zoom call with Sam so that he could help me identify if I was on an optimised electricity plan to ensure that I was saving as much money as possible with our new solar system. Sam was kind, professional and made doubly sure that I was satisfied with the outcome of the project.Overall, it is astounding just how far KPE is willing to go to get their customers the best result. If you're like me, and you've got no clue about solar, I can assure you that you'll be safe with KPE. The quality of their work is phenomenal and their customer service is top-notch.

Only quoter to actually visit the house ( twice) rather than just google earth and email . Met household needs good price with excellent installation and follow up service . Highly recommend them . Many thanks

Finding a trustworthy solar installer can be a daunting task, especially with the overwhelming amount of information available to first time buyers. After doing my research, I was fortunate to connect with SolarQuotes, which introduced me to three reputable installers. After speaking with each one, it quickly became clear that Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical was the best fit for my project.From the initial consultation to the completion of the installation, I was thoroughly impressed with the professionalism and attention to detail demonstrated by Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical. One standout feature was their use of a WhatsApp group for clear and transparent communication, allowing both the client and the team to stay updated. The lead installer, Angus, regularly uploaded drone photos and videos of the work throughout the installation and explained what was happening on the roof, which was invaluable. Let’s face it most homeowners aren’t going to be on the roof themselves to see the work firsthand.My roof posed a unique challenge due to its Boral terracotta shingles, which are delicate and require extra care. However, the young and energetic team handled the job with remarkable expertise. They ensured the entire installation was carried out with the utmost care over two days, making sure everything was perfect. To preserve the integrity of the roof, they installed Wakkaflex on every tile bracket to prevent any potential water penetration, a concern I had been worried about for years.Additionally, they did a fantastic job concealing all the electrical cables, which was a big concern for us. We didn’t want any wires exposed, and they managed this flawlessly. They also took care of all the paperwork for grid connection and demonstrated how the Enphase app works, which was very helpful.What truly sets Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical apart is their commitment to ongoing customer care. Even after the job was completed, they stayed in touch. About 8-12 weeks after installation, a team member sets up a Zoom meeting with the client to review bills, compare rates and follow up on solar performance. This level of customer service speaks volumes about their dedication to long term satisfaction.I’m confident that Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical will be around for many years to come. Their team is young, driven, talented and genuinely committed to delivering exceptional service. I wholeheartedly recommend them, especially for homeowners with terracotta tiles. They are, without a doubt, the best in the business. I was so impressed with their work that I referred them to my mum, who has since had solar panels installed by them as well.Great job, and thanks again!

Kennedy’s whole team from admin to technical to installation and all others involved are a professional outfit. From beginning to end full support total understanding and always attending customers request. This group is  who you want doing your solar. Thanking them and will always recommend them.

I recently had Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical replace my old solar system with a new one, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the entire process. From start to finish, Angus and his team were professional, courteous and respectful of my property. They arrived on time, worked efficiently and left everything tidy, which is something I really appreciate.One of the standout features of their service was their expertise with Boral terracotta shingles. Many installers shy away from working with these delicate tiles but the team at Kennedys handled them with care and precision, ensuring a low number tiles would be damaged during the installation. It’s clear that they have extensive experience with this type of roofing.The job was completed perfectly and I’m extremely satisfied with my new solar system. I highly recommend Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical for anyone looking for reliable, professional and skilled solar installation services. Thank you again, Angus and the team, for your outstanding work!

KPE (Kennedy’s Plumbing & Electrical) + Solar what an AMAZING and OUTSTANDING company to deal with from the start to the finish. These guys are the real deal experts when it comes to solar systems. They use high quality products throughout install to match the high end solutions they provide.Dan with his expertise in solar solutions made it simple to understand when he visited my house. He ran through all the options available and recommended the best for our needs.Once the installation team arrived with their electricians everything was seamless. These are one of best tradespersons I have dealt with. Professional, courteous, very well organised company.The final installation was exceptional, looks fantastic. Now looking forward to getting a battery to complete my green energy transformation to be off the grid. This will all occur when KPE analyse my new energy consumption profiles with all the stats off my solar system.Post installation calls have been  scheduled for further optimisation.KPE with Angus and the team should be utilised always when it comes to solar…..5 stars.Note all, I don’t generally write reviews but this company is impressive hence I have taken the time to do one.Keep up the high standards KPE.

Such a refreshing experience from this young company. From the initial contact following an Instagram search, KPE really shone through with prompt follow-up, informative answers to my questions, and a thoroughly easy process to quote and discuss our particular job. Our passive solar, energy efficient home was built 26 years ago and has a roof pitch of 41 degrees. Over the past 20 years, we have engaged numerous companies to install solar panels - however they all baulked at the roof pitch and just gave up on us. Not so KPE! With their 'can-do' attitude and professional approach to the installation, they won us over and we are so grateful for their determination to help. In one day with 8 professional tradesmen, they were up on the roof in no time with their climbing skills, strapped to the ridge cap and swinging like Tarzan installing our solar panels. We had 28 panels installed, battery backup set up and a neat and tidy exterior when they left. Customer service was exceptional with our own Whatsapp group holding it all together. Grid connection was handled, moving supplies painless. After Angus showed me the solar app, I can hardly stop watching it all day to see how much we are saving and how much power I can push back to the grid. Exceptional experience from this company. I have no hesitation in recommending their services as top-notch.
The experience with Kennedy's has been a breeze - from sales, advice & comms through to installation.  I can absolutely recommend Kennedy's for your solar installation.

I was a fussy customer but they persevered with four or five different designs until we got the very best one for my circumstances. Appreciated that guys.On the installation day they arrived on time with the necessary number of people and equipment. It was not the easiest installation but they worked up til 7:00 pm to complete it on the day. The site was left neat and tidy, even checking the driveway for any stray screws.They organised  all aspects of the installation and got me up and running with the monitoring apps. The team was in constant communication through WhatsApp, so I knew what was happening all the time.We monitored the system for three months the proceeded to pick a battery to suit. The installation of the battery was a repeat performance of the sole panel installation. Need I say more.Couldn't be happier with the results and appreciated that the team responded to every question I had, which were numerous. Thanks for a great experience. I don't believe any one else could match it.

Kennedy's was not the cheapest quote but they provide a technical solution to reduce the potential for future roof leaks with our flat roof tiles.  No other supplier offered this.Overall, I have been very impressed by the service provided by all the staff at Kennedy's from quoting stage through installation and onto to advice for getting the best rates after the install.Highly recommended.

Three months in and the setup  continues to tick along. The team installed 16.5kW, a second Powerwall and a heat pump HWS which was tested over the last four days with no grid connection following the storms in Sydney. The system didn’t skip a beat and we barely noticed that there was no connection.The team could see the status of the grid and were responsive to any questions.Great team and I highly recommend.

KPE did our solar install, we got 3 quotes and KPE were the only company to come out for a site visit prior to giving us a quote. This meant they could purposely ascertain our needs with a proper meeting and also with the use of a drone get a birds eye of the roof to complete the design. Couple this with great communication and pricing and no pushy sales and it was a great experience over all. Installation went smoothly and the system was up and running that afternoon. They also keep on contact afterwards and we are about to have our follow up meeting to go through our rates and usage and make sure we are on the best plan for us. Very happy with the whole process. Would 100% recommend.

The quoting process was easy and everything was explained to me.The team of guys arrived on time.They were very polite and went out of their way to do the best installation by moving the inverter to the garage on the opposite side of the house.Excellent customer service I couldn't be happier.They helped me install the app and explained how to use it.They also assisted with grid connection , monitored the system and suggested the best electricity providers .

After reviewing quotes from multiple installers I chose to go with Kennedys Plumbing and Electrical. The clinchers for me were their patience with my (many) questions, their efforts to identify the best solution for my home, and their commitment to maintaining a relationship post-installation, which made me feel confident they stand by their work. The installation itself went great and their team were tidy, polite and punctual. They helped to configure monitoring and grid connection after install, and attended the site a few days later to remedy minor issues, which was greatly appreciated.The system looks great and is working extremely well. Very happy customer.

Our house had a complex roof layout and significant shading from nearby trees, making solar installation a challenge. After receiving multiple quotes from different installers, we found KPE to offer the most expert advice following a detailed site inspection. In the days that followed, Daniel promptly and thoroughly answered all our questions. They provided quotes for various configurations and options, including monitoring, diversion, and three-phase power upgrades.On installation day, the team arrived on time and worked efficiently. They installed 23 panels with inverters, iBoard, and monitoring devices neatly and optimally. Great care was taken to seal all ingress points, and no damage was done to the roof—they even replaced some cracked tiles. They also removed an existing redundant TV antenna to eliminate any potential shading issues.After the installation, Tino provided a detailed rundown of the system configuration and a walkthrough of the Enphase and Catch Control apps. They did all the paperwork required by the DNSP.I am extremely satisfied with the service from KPE and have no hesitation in recommending them. I will definitely be using their services again in the future.

I went down the rabbit hole when getting quotes for a new Solar system. I had spoken to eight different companies before I found Kennedy’s Plumbing & Electrical.Wow, Daniel their sales rep was on time, polite, so knowledgeable and patiently answered all my questions. He is an asset to the company.Once I accepted the quote, communication lines through a WhatsApp group was set up, allowing everyone in the team to correspond, including myself.I was kept up to date and the Solar installation went ahead as planned a month later. The team of four worked tirelessly, having the Solar system functioning that afternoon.The men was polite, respectful and cleaned up after themselves. No question I asked on the day was a problem.I felt very supportive throughout the whole process, and still do. The WhatsApp group continues and if you have a question AFTER the system if installed, you can communicate with the team.  Someone will get back to you very quickly. I know because last week my question was answered within minutes, thanks Angus.Lastly, Daniel their sales rep follows up with you about a month after installation, once he can see how the Solar is being used in the household. He recommends the best energy company for you, to make the most of your new Solar system.Seriously, I’m so impressed with Kennedy’s Plumbing & Electrical. If you are looking for perfection, give these guys a call. They have all the gadgets including a drone to inspect your roof on the first meeting. After the job is completed, a video of your new Solar is added to your WhatsApp group, so you can see the finished product close up.Amazing stuff, and their after sales support continues for the life of your system. Just ring them and save yourself the time & agony I went through with the other Solar companies

Great team at KPE, from beginning to end the whole team were polite, professional, honest reliable and nice to deal with.  Very good interaction with Daniel during the quoting process, providing a wealth of information throughout and demonstrating a very high level of technical knowledge which helped to build my confidence in the quality and dedication to customer service of this team. Installation was seamless, and the install crew were fantastic, and took the time and trouble to keep all wiring within the walls which wasn't straightforward, so no conduit on external side of house. They did a very professional job, were very polite and very clean and got the job done efficiently with no hassles.  Whilst price is most people's primary focus, I'd recommend not buying on price alone as you can't put a price on the additional value offered by the likes of KPE - great customer service, top notch technical advice, professional install crews, great after sales service. These are all value add that make KPE a really strong value for money offering, that you know are going to be around to continue to support long after completion of the install. Highly recommended.

From the moment I met Dan, the sales guy I knew we had a front runner. His knowledge and genuine nature was very evident, and major reason for my decision. The installer, Angus and his team were fantastic from start to finish and I am very happy with their workmanship and ongoing support I am receiving. It was a bonus that I could support a local installer.

Great advice and customer service by the team, very happy with timely responses and support through tge process if purchasing a bew solar system for the first time. I would highly recommend them to anyone.

This has been a wonderful experience from start to finish.Starting with Dan, the sales experience was great. He was very friendly and helpful. Explained everything great and developed a system to suit our needs.Installation day came and Tino & the crew couldn’t have been better. All very professional and tidy, kept us updated with progress and took a video to show us what they had done on the roof. Inverter was installed seamlessly and works and looks great. Tino explained how to use the system and how everything works very clearly.Customer service of this company is fantastic. They’ve been quick to respond to any queries and follow the theme of them all being super helpful. They have kept in touch and helped out in finding an energy plan that suits our usage.I have no trouble recommending Angus and the business. I’ve been raving about them to anyone that I speak to about solar.

Great service from start to finish. From the quote, the representative took the time and also had answers to all questions and there was never any pressure. At install, the team were great. Completed on schedule and in one day. After sales service so far has been spot on as well. Would highly recommend.

After much research and receiving several quotes I selected Kennedy's Plumbing and Electrical for the installation of my 10.4 kWh system. They impressed me from the moment I began the quoting process with them. Daniel was both knowledgeable and professional. The information he provided confirmed much of my own research.  Once I had accepted their quote Kennedy's communication was excellent. By using a group in WhatsApp you are instantly updated during all stages of the booking and installation process. I could also put any questions I had in the lead up to the install to them through WhatsApp and have them answered promptly.On the day of installation Angus and his team arrived punctually at the agreed time. They set to work with the efficiency of a group that obviously works well together. In about six hours the job was complete, including the removal of all waste packaging etc. On inspection I found the work to be neat and professional .The drone photos of the installation were excellent.I was taken through a quick run down of the system and given instructions on downloading and using then Enphase App.It's been around six weeks since the install and the follow up Zoom meeting to discuss, based on my usage and production, whether I was with the most cost effective energy provider was an added bonus service.I would have no hesitation in recommending Kennedy's Plumbing & Electrical for any size solar installation.

Daniel took the time to assess our property and understand my current and future energy needs. Angus and the team handled the installation flawlessly and took care of all the paperwork. The way that these guys communicate is next level, happy with everything so far.
Absolute professional experience, great installation and service. I recommend Kennady's for anyone who needs Solar.
